provider: pCloud PhotoDay2026 promo — 500 GB free for 3 months

free_tier.stated: 500 GB free for 3 months, no card, via promo code `PhotoDay2026` on a fresh signup. Base free tier is 10 GB.

egress.terms: Same as pCloud paid — unrestricted transfer speeds, no per-GB meter.

tooling: rclone backend `pcloud` — the trial grant is a normal quota bump, so rclone works unchanged against it.
chaining: The grant repeats: a new email address creates a new account that holds a new 500 GB for 3 months. 4 grant cycles a year x N email addresses. 10 email addresses = 5 TB of rolling free capacity. The friction is re-uploading data each cycle and that rclone remotes must be re-authed per account.
limits_note: 3-month expiry hard-stop; capacity reverts to 10 GB (data above the free cap becomes read-only or is reclaimed). No card, so no auto-charge risk. Promo codes rotate seasonally — this one is a 'Photography Day' code live since at least 2026-08-13.
reliability_note: Highest-confidence repeatable trial found. It is a marketing code, not a security hole, so it is unlikely to be retroactively enforced; but pCloud can invalidate a code at any time. Verified the promo-redemption page is live; did not burn an account to confirm the grant lands.
